# Graph Simulator

> A free, browser-based tool for creating and exploring simple undirected graphs.

Create word- or letter-labeled vertices, connect them, inspect components and cycles, and compare neighbor lists, adjacency matrices, and edge lists. JSON files are processed in the browser.
